response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactionrecord AS r JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count::numeric) AS average_count, SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count FROM type_counts) SELECT c.tradekind, c.transaction_count, c.transaction_count::numeric / s.total_count AS share_of_total, c.transaction_count - s.average_count AS count_above_average FROM type_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS s WHERE s.average_count IS NOT NULL AND c.transaction_count > s.average_count;
